# Vectorizing constructor with two seeds

Original generic constructors retain the typed interface conversion and the
same converter, two independent Object-bound seeds and nominally bounded tail.
The full conversion result signature selects the original same-owner overload.
Frozen direct, precompiled, reflection and method-handle observers check nulls,
input identity, exact conversion order and partial final-field state after
failures. Four wrong programs must fail the observer; input bytecode and
metadata remain compiler output.
